name: Stellar Reflections
source:
A short story visual novel set in a dystopian future, where Earth and Mars are used exclusively as mining facilities, while most of human population resides in space stations around the planets and the Moon. In this bleak era, personal freedoms have been suppressed, and life choices are dictated by the all-powerful regime.

Delve into the narrative through the eyes of the protagonist, Aurelia, a nobody spending her days at her junkyard job, in a bar, or holed up in her cabin. What will she do when the government makes a decision directly affecting her life, and she's far from being a fan of it. 
Observe has she comes to face a life-altering decision that will challenge her perception of the world.

[from [url=https://badgercanfly.itch.io/stellar-reflections]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部设定在反乌托邦未来的短篇视觉小说：地球与火星已彻底沦为单纯的采矿基地，绝大多数人类则栖居在环绕行星与月球运行的空间站中。在这个灰暗压抑的时代，个人自由遭到严酷打压，人生的一切选择皆由大权独揽的政权一手包办。

透过主人公奥蕾莉亚的双眼深入这段故事吧——身为无名小卒的她，平日里不是在废品场干活、泡在酒吧里，就是窝在狭小的舱室中度日。当政府做出一项直接波及她切身生活、却令她深恶痛绝的决定时，她会如何应对？
静观她如何直面这一足以改写人生的重大抉择，以及这场冲击她既有世界观的考验吧。

[摘自[url=https://badgercanfly.itch.io/stellar-reflections]itch.io[/url]]
